verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS cap-table platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only feature-specific outputs: an ASC 718 report generated as .xlsx, and scenario exports in an unspecified format. These are adjacent reporting features, not a documented way to export all account data in open formats and leave, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
